newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly up, spot July down.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly up, spot July down.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly higher on Tuesday, as technical buying supported the market in the afternoon session, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.3 yen lower to 1.2 yen higher, with the benchmark December contract up 1.2 yen at 114.0 yen per kg.
All months were lower during the morning trade, as position adjustment at the spot month pushed down others, traders said. But technical buying orders emerged later, they said.
The July month expires on July 25. As of July 18, the spot contract had 4,581 lots of open interests.
